# troubleshooting

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom                                      | Likely cause                                            | Fix                                                                         |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Gallery collapses or moves after load        | Missing dimensions or missing structure CSS             | Use real intrinsic dimensions and keep `css: 'structure'` or `css: 'all'`.  |
| Lightbox opens from the wrong frame          | Thumbnail identity or dimensions do not match           | Use stable IDs, correct dimensions, and `PhotoTrigger` for custom layouts.  |
| Nuxt Image mode throws during setup          | `@nuxt/image` is missing or not registered              | Install it in any module order, or use `auto` or `native`.                  |
| Direct Vue package import fails under pnpm   | The app does not declare the package it imports         | Import from `@lupinum/nuxt-photo/app` or add `@lupinum/vue-photo` directly. |
| Custom lightbox has empty or duplicate state | It creates a second provider inside a recipe override   | Remove `provideLightbox()` from the override.                               |
| Custom thumbnail ignores image configuration | It renders a raw `<img>`                                | Render `<PhotoImage>` or accept that the adapter is bypassed.               |
| Signed URLs cause hydration mismatch         | URLs are signed with time or random state during render | Pre-sign before render and store deterministic URLs on `PhotoItem`.         |
| Carousel autoplay feels unpredictable        | Interaction settings do not match the intended behavior | Set `delayMs`, `stopOnInteraction`, and `stopOnMouseEnter` explicitly.      |

## Inspect the application

```bash
rg "nuxtPhoto|@lupinum/(nuxt|vue)-photo|@nuxt/image|PhotoAlbum|PhotoGroup|PhotoCarousel|provideLightbox" .
```

Check the package manager, Nuxt configuration, image pipeline, CSS mode, and whether imports are automatic or explicit.

## Verify the fix

```bash
pnpm exec nuxi prepare
pnpm exec vue-tsc -p .nuxt/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
pnpm build
```

Then test thumbnail opening, next and previous navigation, Escape closing, mobile width, keyboard focus, and visible layout movement.

_Source: `docs/content/docs/6.help/1.troubleshooting.md`_

## Intentional sharp edges

Nuxt Photo tries to fail loudly at public boundaries, but a few choices still
matter for correctness and maintainability.

## Photo data

Every photo needs a stable `id`, `src`, `width`, and `height`. Duplicate ids are
invalid. Recipe components validate photo lists before layout math runs, and the
default policy is `validation="throw"`.

Use `validation="drop"` only when losing invalid photos is acceptable and you
handle the `invalidPhotos` event. Silent data loss should not be the default for CMS or
API regressions.

## PhotoGroup ownership

`<PhotoGroup>` receives one explicit `photos` collection. That collection owns
identity and navigation order; descendant `<Photo>` and `<PhotoAlbum>` recipes
only contribute thumbnail elements and optional custom slide renderers.

```vue
<PhotoGroup :photos="[...landscapes, ...studies]">
  <PhotoAlbum :photos="landscapes" />
  <PhotoAlbum :photos="studies" />
</PhotoGroup>
```

A group mounted with `lightbox=false` is inert. It does not create a provider
later if the prop changes. Mount a new enabled group when you need a provider.

## CSS

`css: 'structure'` is the minimum viable module setting. `css: 'none'` means you
own every structural class needed for album layout, carousel layout, lightbox
positioning, focus behavior, and transitions.

## Custom adapters and lightboxes

Custom image adapters should be deterministic for SSR. The same photo and
context should produce the same result on server and client.

Custom lightbox components should consume the provider created by Nuxt Photo.
Do not create a second provider inside the custom lightbox unless you are
intentionally replacing the full state model.

## Carousel

`PhotoCarousel` exposes only library-owned options. It uses one slide per snap
and stable Embla methods; Embla options, plugins, and engine internals are not a
public extension point. Run the browser suite before changing the Embla version,
direction, containment, or slide sizing.

## One active lightbox

Only one provider owns modal focus and page isolation at a time. Opening another
lightbox first closes the current owner. This prevents competing focus traps,
inert page state, and ambiguous keyboard ownership.

_Source: `docs/content/docs/6.help/2.sharp-edges.md`_
